description: Lower ground floor rear extension, new windows, internal alterations including internal wall insulation to external walls
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p>Structural method statement Prior to the commencement of works on the development, a Structural Method Statement shall be prepared by an appropriately qualified and experienced structural engineer (and/or specialist timber designer) and shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The Method Statement shall briefly explain how the wooden beam in the kitchen will be fitted into the joists above including methods of fixing and how the floor above will be supported during works The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Method Statement. REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Sections 16 and 66 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework,&nbsp; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1 Heritage conservation and growth; and Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policies LP1 Design Quality and Local Character, and LP3 Designated Heritage Assets.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of works on the development, the following details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. </p><p>a) Details of results of the foundation trial pit survey including the depth, design and extent of the historic foundations </p><p>b) A method statement outlining the works necessary to lower the ground floor level, including an assessment of the impact of lowering the floor on the historic foundations </p><p>c) Details of the opening up works to the basement vaults, including the existing condition of the vaults and the proposed works to make them usable The works shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the details approved. </p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Sections 16 and 66 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework,&nbsp; The London Plan 2021 Policy HC1 Heritage conservation and growth; and Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policies LP1 Design Quality and Local Character, and LP3 Designated Heritage Assets.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>Prior to the commencement of works on the development hereby approved, details of the following works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p>Details of lining system and ventilation for the bathroom;</p><p>Details of internal joinery</p><p>The development hereby approved shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved.</p><p>REASON: To&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building under Sections 16 and 66 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990</span></p>
